issues.description: The problem statement gives two different orders for the Lecture attributes and explicitly instructs students to follow the UML diagram when implementing the constructor. The textual attribute list (which lists lectureName first) conflicts with the UML attribute order (which lists numberOfInscribedStudents first). The provided solution's constructor uses the textual order (lectureName first) rather than the UML order. This inconsistency can confuse students about the required constructor parameter order and which source of truth to follow.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update the UML in problem_statement.md to list lectureName first (matching the textual list and the solution), or (B) change the solution and template constructor signature to follow the UML order (numberOfInscribedStudents first). Also update the textual instructions to explicitly state the chosen order so students know which order to implement.
